name: World: Resting buff 997615 applies in capital city inns and all resting areas (#10436)
contract: AscensionInnRest.cpp previously gated Resting (997615, whose expiry grants Well Rested 997616 for +8% monster-kill XP) on HasRestFlag(REST_FLAG_IN_TAVERN) only. Capital cities and their inns (Stormwind's Gilded Rose, Ironforge's Stonefire Tavern, Orgrimmar's Broken Tusk, Undercity, Thunder Bluff, Darnassus, Silvermoon, Exodar, Dalaran) use REST_FLAG_IN_CITY, and faction rest-zone inns (Valgarde, Westguard Inn, etc.) use REST_FLAG_IN_FACTION_AREA, so none of them ever granted 997615 even though PLAYER_FLAGS_RESTING was active. Checking HasPlayerFlag(PLAYER_FLAGS_RESTING) && IsAlive() covers taverns, capital cities, and faction rest zones uniformly. An Alliance character standing by Innkeeper Allison (6740) in Stormwind's Gilded Rose must receive 997615 without a tavern area trigger, lose it when teleporting outdoors to Elwynn Forest, regain it inside Goldshire's Lion's Pride Inn (area trigger 562), and lose it upon death.

steps.label: Let login and zone rest flags settle in Stormwind
SETUP: Stormwind Gilded Rose sets PLAYER_FLAGS_RESTING via REST_FLAG_IN_CITY
DISCRIMINATING: capital city inn grants Resting buff 997615
Leave Stormwind for Elwynn Forest outdoors
Leaving the resting area removes unfinished Resting buff 997615
Tavern resting still grants Resting buff 997615
Dying inside a rest area drops unfinished rest
Dead player does not retain Resting buff 997615
